g.text: Device USB-C, ESD (SP0503), fuse, VBUS sense

g.desc: Device USB-C, ESD (SP0503), fuse, VBUS sense

g.text: 5 V select, 3.3 V LDO, power LED

g.desc: 5 V select, 3.3 V LDO, power LED

g.text: EoS TM4C123 Board, rev A, BoosterPack-compatible (40-pin). Designed by Kartikeydheer Srivastava.

g.desc: EoS TM4C123 Board, rev A, BoosterPack-compatible (40-pin). Designed by Kartikeydheer Srivastava.

g.text: Values from TI SPMS376E (TM4C123GH6PM) and SPMA059; Silicon Labs CP2102N Rev. 1.5; Diodes DS37274; Littelfuse SP05xxBA;

g.desc: Values from TI SPMS376E (TM4C123GH6PM) and SPMA059; Silicon Labs CP2102N Rev. 1.5; Diodes DS37274; Littelfuse SP05xxBA;

g.text: NDK NX3225GA; Abracon ABS07; Nexperia BAT54J; onsemi MMBT3904; Wurth 150141M173100; Kingbright.

g.desc: NDK NX3225GA; Abracon ABS07; Nexperia BAT54J; onsemi MMBT3904; Wurth 150141M173100; Kingbright.

g.text: Firmware: set OSCDRV (C14/C15 20 pF); USB as a forced device, VBUS on PB3;

g.desc: Firmware: set OSCDRV (C14/C15 20 pF); USB as a forced device, VBUS on PB3;

g.text: unlock PF0 and PD7 (GPIOLOCK 0x4C4F434B, GPIOCR) before using them.

g.desc: unlock PF0 and PD7 (GPIOLOCK 0x4C4F434B, GPIOCR) before using them.

g.text: JP1 (one shunt): 1-2 device port powers the board, 2-3 debug port; do not feed J3.21 with JP1 fitted,

g.desc: JP1 (one shunt): 1-2 device port powers the board, 2-3 debug port; do not feed J3.21 with JP1 fitted,

g.text: nor J1.1 ever (3.3 V output). 3.3 V budget 300 mA in all, about 225 mA of it for BoosterPacks.

g.desc: nor J1.1 ever (3.3 V output). 3.3 V budget 300 mA in all, about 225 mA of it for BoosterPacks.

g.text: CP2102N on 3.3 V; R31 bleeds VDBG so its VBUS pin reads low with no debug host. J3.29/J3.30, PB2 open.

g.desc: CP2102N on 3.3 V; R31 bleeds VDBG so its VBUS pin reads low with no debug host. J3.29/J3.30, PB2 open.

g.text: CP2102N USB-UART (on 3.3 V, VBUS sense + bleed)

g.desc: CP2102N USB-UART (on 3.3 V, VBUS sense + bleed)
